filename: Task Aware Modulation Using Representation Learning for Upsaling of Terrestrial Carbon Fluxes.pdf
title: Task Aware Modulation using Representation Learning for Upsaling of Terrestrial Carbon Fluxes
testbed_rationale: The study evaluates an upscaling framework across existing observational networks and remote sensing products, but does not provide a downloadable packaged ML benchmark dataset or public code repository.
pain_points: Sparse and regionally biased distribution of eddy covariance tower measurements (concentrated in North America and Europe)
Poor generalization and high uncertainty when transferring ML models to unseen biomes, climates, and unobserved regions (covariate shift)
Context-dependency of flux-feature relationships across varying weather conditions
Differences in spatio-temporal resolution, noise characteristics, and coverage across input data modalities
Severe underperformance on underrepresented ecosystem types like water bodies (WAT) due to missing aquatic process variables
extraction_notes: Accepted to the non-archival KGML Bridge at AAAI 2026. The paper addresses terrestrial carbon flux upscaling formulated as a zero-shot domain generalization regression task, constrained by the carbon balance equation.
